name: ai-coding-alerts
description: Get a sound, an OS notification, and window focus when Claude Code or another AI agent is waiting for your confirmation.

aiCodingAlerts.popupSound.description: Sound for a popup that is waiting for your decision (permission request with options). Choose 'custom' to use your own file.

aiCodingAlerts.finishedSound.description: Sound for a finished AI response. Choose 'custom' to use your own file.

aiCodingAlerts.popupCustomSoundPath.description: Absolute path to your own sound file for popup alerts, used when Popup Sound is 'custom'.

aiCodingAlerts.finishedCustomSoundPath.description: Absolute path to your own sound file for finished-response alerts, used when Finished Sound is 'custom'.

aiCodingAlerts.enablePopupSound.description: Play a sound when a popup is waiting for your decision.

aiCodingAlerts.enableFinishedSound.description: Play a sound when the AI finishes a response.

aiCodingAlerts.popupAlertDelay.description: Grace period in seconds before a popup alert plays. If you act on the popup first, the alert is dismissed; 0 alerts immediately.

aiCodingAlerts.finishedAlertDelay.description: Seconds of silence required before a finished-response alert plays. Intermediate completions while Claude keeps working are skipped; 0 alerts on every completion.

aiCodingAlerts.enableOsNotification.description: Show an OS-level notification on an alert.

aiCodingAlerts.enableWindowFocus.description: Bring the VS Code window to the foreground on an alert.

aiCodingAlerts.port.description: Local port the extension listens on for agent alerts.

aiCodingAlerts.enableTelegramPush.description: Also send alerts to your phone via a Telegram bot. Requires a bot token and chat ID below.

aiCodingAlerts.telegramBotToken.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (looks like 123456:ABC-DEF...). Used when Telegram push is enabled.

aiCodingAlerts.telegramChatId.description: Your Telegram chat ID (get it from @userinfobot). The bot sends alerts to this chat.

aiCodingAlerts.escalationRepeats.description: If you don't respond to a popup, repeat its sound this many times. 0 turns repeating off. Responding (or a new alert) stops it.

aiCodingAlerts.escalationInterval.description: Seconds to wait between repeated popup sounds.
